bio: I’m Liam, a mechatronics engineer with 6+ years in surgical and construction robotics, based in Bergen, Norway.

I was the first engineering hire at Rockslice, where I build explosive-free robotic rock and concrete cutting, and I am an industrial PhD candidate at NTNU’s Field Robotics Lab, working on advanced control and material sensing for that platform.
Before that I was an early engineer on Johnson & Johnson’s Ottava surgical robot at Ethicon (formerly Auris).
I hold an M.Sc. in Mechatronics from MCI Innsbruck and a B.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo.
